name: cloudfront-keyvaluestore
description: Amazon CloudFront KeyValueStore Service to View and Update Data in a KVS Resource

subcommands.name: delete-key
subcommands.description: Deletes the key value pair specified by the key.

subcommands.name: describe-key-value-store
subcommands.description: Returns metadata information about Key Value Store.

subcommands.name: list-keys
subcommands.description: Returns a list of key value pairs.

subcommands.name: put-key
subcommands.description: Creates a new key value pair or replaces the value of an existing key.

subcommands.name: update-keys
subcommands.description: Puts or Deletes multiple key value pairs in a single, all-or-nothing operation.
